study_note: TD-AMBI full entropy autotemp objective-family variant. The outer temperature is learned from initial alpha 1e-4 toward explicit scaled-entropy target -441; Q normalization is disabled. Entropy-augmented critics bootstrap with Q + alpha * H_scaled because Q normalization is disabled. Actors use literal TD-MPC2 scaled entropy, smooth tanh log-standard-deviation mapping over [-10, 2], and mean-pair Q; critics use min-pair targets and distributional cross-entropy coefficient 0.1. Each real decision uses J=6, N=512, H=3, inner minibatch 512, and replay capacity 9,216 retaining the complete solve. After every batched imagined depth step, 512 new transitions earn one paired critic-then-actor update and target interpolation; this gives 18 paired updates and 9,216 imagined transitions per decision. Minibatches sample accumulated imagined replay, and inner losses use ordinary transition means without sequence-level rho weighting. Inner targets initialize from the outer target critic. The inner temperature is learned toward target -441 after every paired update and initializes from the current outer temperature at each real action. Its temperature gradient is not clipped, matching outer alpha training. Q normalization is disabled inside the solve. All step checkpoints and adjacent metadata are retained every 25,000 decisions; separate final trial saves are disabled. All variants retain Humanoid Walk state observations, seed 55, 2 million decisions, outer batch 256, UTD=1, H=3, rho=0.5, model-size 5, and the other TD-AMBI backbone settings. Controller evaluation, paired controller evaluation, real-environment value evaluation, value-equivalence diagnostics/loss, and imagined diagnostics are disabled. This is a single-seed exploratory comparison, not confirmatory evidence. Each completed run produces 80 scheduled checkpoints.
